lines.trans: Our ratings have caught up with Osipenko's? Wonderful, let's go!
Forget about these flowers. You'll see everything yourself right now.
Marina, it was something awful! Alla Evgenyevna got sick yesterday.
I don't want to hear about Alla Evgenyevna!
Yes, of course. Forgive me, Marina, forgive me.
I'm just foolish. She is lying at home all day.
Then why aren't you with Alla Evgenyevna right now?
Because I love you! I didn't sleep all night.
I wanted to come to you so badly! And in the morning I thought of everything.
I told my wife that I'm going to Plyos. There is an academic conference there.
I left for two days. So we will be together for two days!
How brave you are! And what will you do if she finds out?
I don't care! I want to be only with you, do you understand?
And with Alla Evgenyevna.
No, I have decided everything! She and I will definitely break up.
And everything will change! Marina, just listen to me!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
The main thing is, you keep him at home.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.
I'm with my wife this evening.

заболеть.gloss: to fall ill, to get sick

meanings.en: to fall ill, to come down with an illness

examples.text: Вчера он заболел и остался дома.
examples.trans: Yesterday he fell ill and stayed at home.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.
I was born and grew up here.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

meanings.en: to lie, to be lying down, to rest

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
The book is lying on the table.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
There is an academic meeting there.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night
hesitation, at the start of a sentence
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом
понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: That's why I'm running for a second term.
I'm tired, so I'm at home.

meanings.note: Я прекрасно понимаю = I understand perfectly

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

meanings.note: almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care
поднять рейтинг = to boost someone's poll numbers

examples.trans: The candidate has a high approval rating.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

сравняться.gloss: to become equal, to catch up

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
to see, to catch sight of

уехать.gloss: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)

examples.trans: I'll be gone for an hour.
What a horrible person you are!
I'll find out where he is.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: plural цветы is used for cut flowers / a bouquet

examples.text: Я не могу гулять здесь целый день.
examples.trans: I can't walk around here all day.
We waited for a whole hour.

meanings.note: я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
